run_interactive_web_server: run a ParlAI interactive web server on port 8082 to chat with a model via browser
setup_interactive_agent: set up a ParlAI agent with image mode resnet152 and local human task for interactive chat
create_http_handler: create an HTTP request handler class that serves the interactive chat web UI and handles POST requests
generate_model_response: generate a model response by sending user text and image data to the ParlAI agent
handle_image_upload: handle base64 encoded image uploads and extract features using the ParlAI ImageLoader
